scope: Adds a Router-only, target-free structural-archetype qualification gate, training-only percentile scaling for extreme causal tails, independent adjacent-window stability and soft-overlap checks, a no-label structural-only CLI before any probe may be fitted, an in-place label attachment path that avoids duplicating the full feature panel, and supervised reuse of a previously sealed target-free structural selection. The matched constrained-GMM control retains its compact target-free final frame until its own refit completes and is separately predeclared from the sealed target-free qualification artifact, so it cannot replace the NMF primary.

validation.not_run_reason: The full supervised probe/control funnel is a separate immutable research run; it is not a unit-test substitute.
